issues.description: The solution implementation declares the toString method with return type Object (public Object toString()) and annotates it with @Override. In Java, Object.toString() has the signature public String toString(), so changing the return type to Object prevents a valid override and will cause a compilation error. The problem statement expects a standard toString() that returns a String. This is an inner-artifact type/signature mismatch in the solution that will block compilation and confuse students.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString method signature in the solution to public String toString() and ensure it returns a String. For example: @Override public String toString() { return "Lecture{...}"; } This aligns the solution with Java's Object.toString() contract and the problem statement.
